# Generated macOS link stubs

These text-based library and framework stubs come from the Apache-2.0 licensed
[`apple-sdk-gen`](https://github.com/apple-cross-toolchain/apple-sdk-gen)
release `0.0.4`, asset `stub-sdks-27.0.tar.zst`. That project generates its
framework interfaces from public Apple Developer Documentation. Only the
interfaces used to link Soplang programs are included here. The files contain
symbol names and install names; they do not contain framework implementations.

The source asset's whitespace was normalized. The adjacent `LICENSE` is the
upstream Apache-2.0 license. The macOS package also includes its license notice.
